landing.heroTitle: Iibi wax kasta. Lacag hel. Hal xiriiriye.
landing.heroSubtitle: Ganacsigaaga oo dhan hal xiriiriye — koorsooyin, tababar, faylal, alaabo iyo wax kale. Loo dhisay abuurayaasha Itoobiya.
landing.step1Body: Iska diiwaangeli iimaylkaaga oo keliya — furaha sirta looma baahna.
landing.step2Body: Faylal, koorsooyin, tababar, alaabo — toban dariiqo dakhli.
landing.step3Body: Hal xiriiriye oo ku yaal bio-ga TikTok waa dukaankaaga oo dhan.
landing.step4Body: La soco dakhligaaga oo codso lacag-bixin goor kasta.

builder.title: Cinwaan
builder.zoomNote: Xiriiriyaha Zoom si otomaatig ah ayaa loo abuuraa marka macmiilka ugu horreeya isdiiwaangeliyo.
builder.confirmDelete: Ma tirtiraysaa alaabtan? Macaamiisha iibsaday waxay sii haystaan gelitaankooda.
builder.videoHelpTitle: 📹 Sida loo daro fiidiyowga casharkaaga (tallaabo tallaabo)
builder.vh1: Duub fiidiyowga casharkaaga, kadib fur appka YouTube (ama youtube.com) oo gal. Haddii aadan chanel lahayn, YouTube ayaa bilaash kuugu abuuraya markaad soo gelinayso.
builder.vh2: Taabo badhanka + (Create) → Upload a video → dooro fiidiyowga casharkaaga.
builder.vh3: Tallaabada Visibility, dooro UNLISTED — ma aha Public, ma aha Private. Unlisted waxay ka dhigan tahay fiidiyowgu kama muuqdo raadinta; dadka xiriiriyaha haysta oo keliya ayaa daawan kara.
builder.vh4: Dhammee soo gelinta, kadib fur fiidiyowga oo taabo Share → Copy link.
builder.vh5: Halkan ku soo noqo oo ku dheji xiriiriyahaas sanduuqa fiidiyowga casharka. Waa dhammaatay!
builder.vhNote: Muhiim: weligaa ha dooran Private (ardaydaadu ma daawan karaan), hana ka tirtirin fiidiyowga YouTube hadhow — koorsadaadu halkaas ayay ka ciyaartaa.
